summary: Multi-tenant field operations and business platform with web, desktop, mobile and API apps.

apps.api: Fastify versioned API, OpenAPI routes, jobs and platform tooling
apps.web: Next.js public site, company workspace and platform dashboard
apps.desktop: React app packaged with Tauri for staff and company builds
apps.mobile: Expo field app with local-first offline operation and sync

shared_packages: core: domain schemas, permissions and navigation
db: Postgres schema, migrations, repositories and seeds
auth and api-client: sessions and typed API access
operations-dom: shared business screens for web and desktop
document-render and eta: documents and Egyptian ETA integration
i18n and tokens: English/Arabic RTL and themes/branding
feature_areas: Field operations, scheduling/execution, timesheets and work forms
Visits and scheduling board, skills and certificates, service contracts, maintenance plans and response deadlines
Offline engineer workflows, media capture and conflict resolution
CRM, customer 360, opportunities, quotes, sales orders and deliveries
Assets, inventory, purchasing, stock tracking and van/site materials
Customer finance, general ledger, HR, expenses, payroll and manufacturing
AI help, permission-scoped insights and confirmed actions
Document generation and Egyptian ETA e-invoicing workflows
Tenant platform administration, plans, audit, branding and localization
notes: Feature availability is gated by tenant modules, plans and permissions.
Root README/roadmap may lag implementation; verify focused source and docs.
ETA live validation and legal certification cannot be inferred from code presence.
